name: Forlorn Rowe
summary: At the northern edge of Raven Hill Cemetery, Forlorn Rowe lies under a shadow of dread. Morbent Fel makes his home on the hill, and his magic raises the restless dead across Duskwood.

sections.title: A Seat of Necromancy
sections.body: Forlorn Rowe rises along the northern edge of Raven Hill Cemetery, its slope lost in gloom. Morbent Fel makes his home atop the hill. The necromancer is responsible for much of the walking dead that haunt the surrounding wilderness. From this height, he directs his skeletal servants with foul enchantments, making Duskwood’s northwestern corner perilous for travelers.

sections.title: Cleansing the Hill
sections.body: Morbent Fel’s hold on Forlorn Rowe cannot be broken with ordinary steel. Dark enchantments protect his body from mortal weapons until relics of holy power weaken him. To bring down the necromancer and break his hold over the woods, adventurers must secure consecrated armaments and strike at the curse smothering the cemetery grounds.

faq.q: Where is the Forlorn Rowe located?
faq.answer: Forlorn Rowe rises along the northern ridge of Raven Hill Cemetery in northwestern Duskwood, overlooking the cemetery.

faq.q: Who lives at the Forlorn Rowe?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel makes his lair at Forlorn Rowe. The powerful necromancer uses dark arcane rites to raise and command the undead wandering Duskwood.

faq.q: Why is Morbent Fel so hard to fight here?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel shields himself with foul sorcery, making ordinary attacks nearly useless until a consecrated relic crafted to dispel his magic strips away his protections.

faq.q: Is the Forlorn Rowe part of the cemetery?
faq.answer: Yes. Forlorn Rowe rises along Raven Hill Cemetery’s northern boundary, overlooking the graves and crypts below.

angles.text: As a paladin, you face dark rites at Forlorn Rowe that defy the Holy Light. Consecrated relics and righteous wrath can pierce the necromancer’s wards.
As an Alliance member, you know that driving Morbent Fel from Forlorn Rowe is vital to restoring some safety to Duskwood’s western border.
